text:
Lena Morris: flagging a weird dip on the weekly KPI card  MQLs are down ~22% while sessions for the same cohort are +9%. Pulled into Pulseboard and the session->mql funnel looks fine yesterday but conversion dropped on the landing. https://pulseboard.internal/redwood/launch-performance
Diego Alvarez: saw this on the heatmap. quick hypothesis: UTM strip on the landing redirect for the Spring webinar series. A few clicks show utm_source=null in the raw logs.
Priya Nair: running a quick query to check utm_null by campaign range 2026-03-18..2026-03-24:
```
SELECT campaign, COUNT(*) AS null_utms
FROM raw.clicks
WHERE event_time BETWEEN '2026-03-18' AND '2026-03-24'
  AND (utm_source IS NULL OR utm_source = '')
GROUP BY campaign
ORDER BY null_utms DESC;
```
Priya Nair: result: 1,120 null utms, ~74% tied to campaign 'spring-series-1' and variants (spring-series-1_v2).
growth-bot: deploy: redirect-normalizer v1.4 rolled out by Evan Cho at 2365001200 (detected 2365001265)
Evan Cho: I shipped the normalizer to dedupe query params and normalize paths last night. It was intended to preserve UTM pairs but looks like one rule strips utm_* when a tracking param exists. I'm reverting that rule now and can push a patch to rehydrate utm from referer if available.
Lena Morris: can we get a quick backfill to see corrected MQLs for last 7 days? we'll need that delta for the weekly KPI deck. If backfill misses some partial data, we'll annotate the card with the expected correction.
Diego Alvarez: plan: 1) Evan rolls back the offending rule (Evan) 2) Priya runs backfill to reconstruct utm from referer/landing params (Priya) 3) I'll add a 'measurement note' to the KPI card and create a temporary corrected series on Pulseboard (Diego).
Evan Cho: rolling back now and opening PR with the fix: https://github.com/redwood-inference/frontend/pull/998. If rollback affects other normalizations I'll call it out.
Priya Nair: starting backfill job, ETA ~90m. Will post the corrected vs raw chart in Notion triage: https://www.notion.so/redwood/triage-spring-series-utms
Lena Morris: thanks. if we're not green by the weekly review (2026-03-24 16:00 UTC) we'll include a slide that explains the measurement window + expected uplift after backfill. :white_check_mark:
Evan Cho: noted. will monitor and ping infra if the backfill needs a maintenance window.
Diego Alvarez: will also alert Sales Ops so quota reporting isn't confused.
